# leostream_gatewaycluster (Resource)

The gatewaycluster resource allows you to create, read, update, and delete gatewayclusters in Leostream.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Public IP address of the gatewaycluster.
- `load_balance_via` (String) Enum: E,P,L
				E: All gateways in the cluster are used for load balancing
				P: Only the login gateway will be used
				L: Only the gateway with the least number of connections will be used
- `name` (String) Display name of the gatewaycluster.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the gatewaycluster.
- `use_src_ip` (Number) Method of source IP filtering
				0: do not use source IP filtering, but random port(default)
				1: use source IP filtering, but same port on gateway and desktop
				2: use source IP filtering, but random port on gateway

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the gatewaycluster.
